theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_lintegral_image_eq_of_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : X → X) (Z : Set X) (D : ℕ → Set X) (u g : X → ℝ≥0∞), Function.Injective f → (∀ Y : Set X, μ Y = 0 → μ (f '' Y) = 0) → (∀ Y : Set X, NullMeasurableSet Y μ → NullMeasurableSet (f '' Y) μ) → NullMeasurableSet Z μ → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i)) → Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (D i) (D j)) → μ (Z \ ⋃ i, D i) = 0 → (∀ i, ∫⁻ y in f '' (Z ∩ D i), u y ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in Z ∩ D i, g x ∂μ) → ∫⁻ y in f '' Z, u y ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in Z, g x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
